name: Mike Johnson
office: Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives; U.S. Representative, Louisiana 4th District
stance: Opposes a moratorium on AI development and prefers that AI companies self-regulate on safety.

statements.text: They can self-police, they can self-regulate. They don't need the government to tell them to slow it down.
We all have a sense of urgency to create guardrails around the technology.
They probably should be summoned together at the White House. And I think we need to go in a big room, close the door and sort this out. And I'll be the one pushing for it.
